fact: Digital minister Cina Lawson announced on 1 October 2026 a cooperation under which Kyrgyzstan is to transmit satellite earth-observation data to Togo, with training and technology transfer, to improve agricultural productivity among other uses.

The Togo AI Lab, run by the digital-transformation ministry with UC Berkeley, uses satellite imagery to track agricultural plots and is building models to forecast annual maize and sorghum production, per the funder FID.

The agriculture ministry states that, with FSRP support, ANAMET has been equipped with a satellite-image reception antenna and now accesses satellite data used for the agro-hydro-climatic forecasts it prepares each year for farmers and planners.

The Togo Data Lab, with Togo's Ministry of Agriculture, is developing a project using satellite images, ground data and AI to support farmers, looking at land use, crop yields and soil fertility (Berkeley News).
